extensionName: Link Library — Local bookmarks & optional sync
shortDescription: Manage Chrome bookmarks locally, sync bookmarks and Reading List to Notion, and optionally add AI summaries and tags.
longDescription: Manage Chrome bookmarks locally. Connect your own Notion integration for optional sync and AI summaries and tags. Self-hosted deployments include scheduled sync and batch AI without an official subscription. Source code is licensed under GPL-3.0-only. Official hosted services may offer Free and Pro plans.

releasedClaims.text: Search and manage Chrome bookmarks locally, including descriptions and tags.
Sync Chrome bookmarks and Reading List to Notion on demand.
Connect securely with managed Notion OAuth.
Avoid duplicate Notion entries with stable link handling.
Use your own AI provider key to generate a concise summary and topic tags for newly saved pages.
Run scheduled background sync with Pro.
Run queued AI processing for newly synced pages with Pro.

features.title: Manage the bookmarks you already have

items.title: Local bookmark management
items.body: Search titles, URLs, descriptions, and tags; edit details, move bookmarks between folders, and remove what you no longer need.

items.title: Bookmarks + Reading List
items.body: Keep both Chrome sources in place and sync them to Notion through one manual workflow.

items.title: Save the current page
items.body: Capture the page you are reading without adding it to Chrome bookmarks first.

items.title: Secure Notion connection
items.body: Choose a Notion workspace through OAuth without sharing your Notion password.

items.title: Clean Notion entries
items.body: Keep useful page details and avoid duplicate entries when the same link is saved again.

items.title: Optional AI summaries + tags

ai.title: Optionally add summaries and tags
ai.body: Enable AI only when you want it. For eligible newly saved public pages, Link Library sends the readable page content needed to create the result to your selected provider.

items.title: Do I need to move my bookmarks into Link Library?
items.body: No. Chrome bookmarks remain your source of truth. Link Library reads and edits them through Chrome, and calculates library counts and duplicate groups inside the extension.

items.title: Can I save a page without bookmarking it first?
items.body: Yes. Save the page open in your current tab directly to your connected Notion database.

items.title: Which pages can use AI, and what is sent?
items.body: AI runs only for newly saved public web pages after you enable it. Excluded, local, and private pages are skipped. For each request, Link Library sends readable page text, the title, a sanitized URL, and the current Description and Tags to your selected provider. It does not keep full page text, raw prompts, or raw responses after processing.

items.title: Will AI overwrite my Notion edits?
items.body: No. Finished items are not processed again automatically. If you change the Description in Notion after saving, Link Library leaves it alone.

items.title: What happens if AI fails?
items.body: Your Notion save remains complete. AI is a follow-up task and never becomes a dependency of the basic sync.

items.title: How does Pro auto-sync work?
items.body: Pro users can enable scheduled background sync with a six-hour minimum interval and turn it off at any time.

items.title: What happens if I cancel Pro?
items.body: Your existing Notion data remains, and the Free manual workflow continues to work. Scheduled sync and Pro batch processing pause.
